description_for_human: Transcribe audio and video files using Google Cloud Speech-to-Text. Supports 20+ languages.
description_for_model: AI plugin for transcribing audio and video files. Capable of recognizing speech in 20+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more. Uses Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API for high-accuracy transcription.
